messages:
maria: Quick pass request — finalizing the product launch blog. Need eyes on: benchmark claim language, testimonial placement, CTA variants for demo vs webinar, and inbound lead routing (HubSpot forms + UTMs). Can the squad do a short review today?

jon: Happy to. I'll check UTMs and HubSpot mapping. Which demo slots are we planning to promote?

lina: I have hero mock ready. Will drop two testimonial blurbs that fit the layout. One is short (20–25 chars) and one is longer (40–60).

alex: I'll run an SEO headline sweep — can we avoid starting the H1 with "Introducing"? SEO prefers action/benefit phrase. Also, can we confirm canonical if we repurpose Medium?

maria: Good call, Alex. Aim for benefit-first H1. Canonical will point to our site; we'll publish elsewhere after a week.

sam: From Sales — prefer CTA flow that funnels high-intent leads to a demo slot booking page (Calendly) and mid-intent to webinar signup. Are we gating the demo behind a qualifying question?

sasha: On benchmark claims: we measured 2.3x throughput vs baseline in our internal eval on 8k context with batching. Legal needs the test config and run script to approve the "2.3x" number.

legal-bot: Reminder: any quantitative claim needs a short reproducibility note + test config attached (runbook or link). Please add before publish.

maria: Sasha — can you add the run command and model/seq-length details in a footnote? Example snippet we can adapt: 
```bash
./run_bench --model redwood-v1 --seq 8192 --batch 32 --warmup 200 --measure throughput
```
That should satisfy legal.

jon: UTMs draft for review: 
```
?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch_post&utm_campaign=redwood_launch_2026&utm_content=cta_demo
```
Map to HubSpot fields: campaign=redwood_launch_2026, content=cta_demo. I'll add hidden fields to the form.

lina: Dropping testimonial copy options in the thread: 
- short: "Cut inference cost in half." — 22 chars
- long: "We reduced token costs and halved latency variance in production." — 51 chars
Which one should be the hero overlay?

alex: Short one for hero overlay (keeps line length clean). Use long in the customer quote section with attribution. Also suggest alt text for hero img: "Redwood dashboard showing latency metrics".

sasha: Added the benchmark footnote draft below; pinging legal for review: 
"Benchmark measured on N=5 runs; baseline=unoptimized runtime; environment: p4d. Model served at seq=8192, prompt distribution representative of internal workloads. Full runbook: <link-to-runbook>"

legal-bot: Looks closer. Need the actual runbook link or attach a PDF. Once that's attached, legal can sign off on the numeric claim.

maria: I'll attach the runbook. Also decision on CTA variants: final plan: primary CTA = "Book a demo" -> Calendly (qualifying question), secondary CTA = "Register for launch webinar" -> HubSpot form. Jon please add hidden UTMs and mapping. Sam can we confirm Calendly qualifies?

sam: Yes, Calendly will include a single qualifying checkbox: "I represent a company with >$1M ARR" (optional). We'll capture company and role fields. Sales will triage those who check the box first.

jon: Done — I added hidden fields and mapping in a draft HubSpot form snippet: 
```html
<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"utm_campaign\" value=\"redwood_launch_2026\">
<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"utm_content\" value=\"cta_demo\">
```
I'll push to the shared forms doc.

lina: Pushed hero mock + testimonial placement to Figma (link in thread). Using teal CTA button color to match site.

maria: Voting check — can we get signoffs by EOD? Quick checklist: 
- Legal: confirm runbook link (legal-bot)
- SEO: headline + meta (alex)
- Design: hero + testimonial (lina)
- Growth: UTMs + HubSpot (jon)
- Sales: demo gating/fields (sam)

alex: SEO ok on headline variants, posted two H1 options in the doc — pick the action-focused one.

legal-bot: Runbook link required before EOD signoff.

sam: Sales ok with gating language.

maria: Thanks team — I'll compile the edits and send to legal once Sasha attaches the runbook. If all green, we target publish tomorrow 10:00 PT and webinar promo goes out same day. :rocket:

jon: :thumbsup: I'll schedule the HubSpot campaign and QA the form mapping after legal signoff.

lina: Will update Figma for publish-ready assets tonight.

sasha: Runbook link attached: <drive/redwood/benchmarks/runbook_2026.pdf> — legal, please re-check.

legal-bot: Received. Reviewing now. Expecting signoff in ~2 hours.

maria: Perfect — thanks all. If anything blocks, ping me directly.
